detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Tangy TD: Hero Tower Defense, Class Based, Roguelite, Item Combining

Strategic tower defense where you play a witch, place class-based towers, equip them with items that grant powerful abilities, combine them, create unique builds & deal ridiculous amounts of damage! Customize your builds with a deep stat system and giant skill tree!

Move around Towers, Fight Big Bosses!

Spend Skillpoints earned by defeating enemies in a giant Skilltree.

Equip and Combine over 100 different items. 

Key Features:

  • Three classes with unique skill sets. Defender, Archer and Healer.

  • A Skill Tree for each class to progress through and grow more powerful.

  • Endless Mode. Test your strategy against waves of enemies that become exponentially more difficult.
